verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a test Customer Area with test cards, ability to simulate declined payments/card brands/CVMs, and a basic testing system for POS transaction scenarios, which lets developers (including AI-native ones building against the API) validate integrations without touching production data. missing for 10: no explicit mention of a fully isolated sandbox mode for AI-agent workflows, no independent/hands-on confirmation of the test environment's fidelity, and no detail on how MCP-server usage interacts with the sandbox/test account.
